split_level: unique peptide_id (all organism rows for a peptide share its split assignment)
post_filtering_note: qmap.toolkit.train_test_split's post_filtering=True (the library default, used here) removes any train-assigned peptide with a similarity edge (>= identity_threshold) to a test peptide, to guarantee train/test independence. This filter only ever removes from train, never test. The peptide_ids in leakage_filter_reassigned_to_test_peptide_ids are exactly the ones this filter removed from train; they are added to test_peptide_ids (also included there) rather than left unassigned or put back in train, since putting them in test does not violate the independence guarantee the filter exists to enforce.
